name: context-kit
description: Context-window management and a manually set behavioral mode (admin/review/ship) for Claude Code sessions — automatic, hook-driven tracking and compaction suggestions, skills for footprint auditing, context-degradation diagnosis, the Write/Select/Compress/Isolate framework, targeted retrieval, and live window-health checks, plus a context-mode skill that sets the session's operating posture (admin/review/ship) on command.
